verification_report.summary:
The full manuscript passes sequential verification in the stated compact connected Kähler setting. No critical errors or gaps remain after checking the auxiliary arguments, source hypotheses, and final deductions.

The numerical restricted volume is used with Collins–Tosatti’s smooth-remainder convention. The trace formula passes through their formula for restricted minimal-current non-pluripolar masses and the corresponding mass identity in SGPT; it does not identify absolutely continuous and non-pluripolar products for arbitrary bounded-remainder potentials. The trace multiplier theorem supplies exactly the image-ideal inclusion needed later. The dS limits, P-preorder comparisons, rooftop mass bound, and integrability proof of the ideal comparison are valid in their actual background classes. See [CT22](https://arxiv.org/html/1608.07089) and [SGPT](https://mingchenxia.github.io/Lectures/SGPT_final.pdf).

The domination lemma correctly obtains a positivity constant independent of the potential and perturbation parameter: its nef intersection bound is computed on the fixed base, Xiao’s criterion applies on each resolution, and descent plus Lelong semicontinuity preserves the required divisorial domination. [Xiao15](https://aif.centre-mersenne.org/item/10.5802/aif.2959.pdf)

The quantitative regularization proof establishes the claimed class-uniform O(1/m) loss. Holomorphic changes of frame cancel the smooth background potentials, the Hörmander correction preserves point evaluation, and the fixed-cover estimates control kernel gluing. DEL00 Proposition 1.2 applies with the correctly rescaled weight. Only the resulting singularity lower bound is used for the ambient current; smooth-remainder analyticity is not assumed there. [DEL00](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0002035)

Relative principalization uses the correct marked-ideal controlled transforms in the complex analytic category, and its restriction identities yield the stated effective-divisor decomposition. The positivity constants are fixed before M wherever required. Later metrics, neighborhoods, and collar constants may depend on the chosen modification. On each compact collar disjoint from W, the coefficient inequalities give actual bounded-error potential domination, sufficient for maximum gluing. [BM08](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0702375)

Finally, the glued current is smooth near a point that the non-Kähler-locus transformation rule places in that locus, giving the required contradiction. The non-big reduction, absence of isolated components, and positivity of restricted volumes outside the non-Kähler locus establish both inclusions in the asserted equality.
